WITH per_event_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        link_to_event,
        AVG(spent) as avg_spent,
        AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
global_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) as mean_avg_remaining
    FROM per_event_avg
)
SELECT 
    per_event_avg.link_to_event,
    per_event_avg.avg_spent,
    per_event_avg.avg_remaining,
    per_event_avg.avg_remaining - global_mean.mean_avg_remaining as difference
FROM per_event_avg
CROSS JOIN global_mean
ORDER BY 
    (per_event_avg.avg_remaining - global_mean.mean_avg_remaining) IS NULL,
    (per_event_avg.avg_remaining - global_mean.mean_avg_remaining) DESC
LIMIT 10
